data.name: Taimanin Squad
data.detailed_description:
The world is in turmoil as peace is shattered by the emergence of demons,

The sole hope of humanity, the Taimanins erupt their ultimates!

Command powerful and captivating characters to stand against the evil that threatens the world!

◆ Strategic Battles

Mix and match various characters and come up with your very own strategy

Enhance your characters through growth content,

Dominate the battle with masterful tactics and an unbeatable squad!

◆ Captivating Characters

A stunning roster of female ninjas you won't be able to take your eyes off!

These captivating characters await your command!

Satisfy your itch by collecting and training numerous characters to unleash their full potential!

◆ Epic Visuals

Breathtaking 3D characters rendered in high-quality graphics!

Train your characters as you wish

Bring your squad to life and crush your enemies in style!

◆ Relationship Scenarios

No more boring RPG battles!

Build a relationship with characters and enjoy exclusive character scenarios!

Hidden stories and charming episodes await you!

◆ Diverse Content

Experience the joy of growth within abundant content!

Complete the collection and develop your characters through various research

From Anihilation Missions, Tactics Research, and Battle Arena,

Test your strategies across multiple combat modes and prove your supremacy!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-2520M or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 500 series or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.6GHz or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 series or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
